name: oh-my-pi
nameMangling: mcp__ + sanitize(server) + _ + sanitize(tool), where sanitize lowercases, turns each run of [^a-z0-9_] into _, collapses runs of _ and trims them; a tool name that starts with the server's part plus _ loses it; the whole is length-capped (V, packages/coding-agent/src/mcp/tool-bridge.ts:464-493 at 18.16.0)
sources: npm @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent and @oh-my-pi/pi-utils 18.16.0 (tag v18.16.0, 650f3a1, in github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi), the TypeScript sources in the tarballs: coding-agent src/discovery/builtin.ts:125-262, src/discovery/helpers.ts:548-588, src/config/resolve-config-value.ts:22-24, 104-108, src/mcp/manager.ts:2115-2145, src/mcp/config-writer.ts:16-21, 60-75, src/mcp/tool-bridge.ts:455-493, src/capability/index.ts:231-264; pi-utils src/dirs.ts:122, 328-336, 353-372, 641-648, src/json.ts:4-10, src/env.ts:360-370 (lane Q, third chat, 3 Nov 2026)
notes: oh-my-pi reads <cwd>/.omp/mcp.json, <cwd>/.omp/.mcp.json, then mcp.json and .mcp.json in its agent folder (~/.omp/agent; PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR replaces it, PI_CONFIG_DIR renames .omp and a named profile (OMP_PROFILE, PI_PROFILE) moves it under profiles/<name>, which derm does not follow), with JSON.parse (no comments), and the first server of a name wins, so a project's entry beats the user's (V, builtin.ts:236-258, capability/index.ts:231). Entries are read loosely: type (stdio, sse, http), command, args, env, cwd, url, headers, auth, oauth, enabled, timeout; other keys are ignored (V, builtin.ts:129-230). ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} are expanded in every string of an entry at load, and an unset ${VAR} stays as literal text (V, helpers.ts:556-570). Then every env and header value is resolved again: one starting with ! runs as a shell command, and one that is exactly the name of a set variable becomes that variable's value (V, manager.ts:2115-2145, resolve-config-value.ts:22-24, 104-108). derm refuses ! in any value (check_text) and a literal header that names a set variable; a secret whose own value starts with ! or equals a variable's name would still be read that way by oh-my-pi. Its own writer (/mcp add) writes $schema first, two-space JSON with no final newline, mode 0600 (V, config-writer.ts:16-21, 60-75).

coverage.note: blocks on a throw and its 30 s timeout (run); confirm is false with no UI; its default approval mode is yolo, so the gate is its only check; the redundant <server>_ prefix is dropped and names over 64 characters get a hash; PI_CONFIG_DIR and PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR move its folders; a later extension that returns {input} still replaces the args derm allowed (lane I, applied by integration w2)
